title: Imp Jar & Wick Liquor O.G.B 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: O.G.B from Imp Jar and Wick Liquor is an adventurous flavour that brings the fun of summer directly to your vape. Imagine the nostalgic taste of a blue raspberry ice pop, its vibrant sweetness perfectly melded with the crispness of apple and the zesty kick of orange. This e-liquid is not just a flavour; it's an experience – one that takes you back to days filled with sunshine, laughter, and the joy of your favourite icy treat. The fusion of these distinct, lively flavours creates a uniquely satisfying vape that never gets dull. This delicious e-liquid is just one of several in an exciting collaboration between Imp Jar and e-liquid legends, Wick Liquor, creators of some of the most unique flavours in vaping. This thrilling partnership means that you can enjoy some of Wick Liquors most iconic creations, with Imp Jar’s 50/50 formulation for use in a wide variety of pod kits and starter kits. Shortfill bottles from Imp Jar E-liquids offer a more versatile ratio of 50PG/50PG than traditional shortfills, which means you can use the e-liquid with a more diverse range of vape kits and coils of different resistances. With Imp Jar shortfills, you’re no longer limited to sub-ohm vaping kits, and can enjoy the superb value of shortfills in a huge variety of MTL vape kits. Each bottle comes with 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 10ml of space for one 10ml nicotine shot, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 1 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills offer even more longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours and are a more economical and convenient option over 10ml bottles of pre-mixed e-liquid. Imp Jar’s original collection of e-liquids replicate a wide array of delicious flavours made popular across numerous disposable vape devices, ranging from fruity delights to frosty menthols, sugary candies, to refreshing beverages.
